prompt: Which country was the first outside of Africa to detect a case of mpox in the most recent outbreak? Note that the first human cases were diagnosed in 1970.
answer: **Sweden** was the first country outside Africa to confirm a case in the most recent mpox outbreak—an imported **clade Ib** case reported on **15 August 2024**. (The first mpox outbreak outside Africa overall was in the United States in 2003.)
